text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sarajevo press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Bosnian Army commander, General Rasim Delic says in an interview that problem with delivery of U.S arms consigned to its "Train and Equip" military programme for Bosnia is due to be resolved in two next days.

- Bosnia, in its post-war period, needs additional financial assistance from the international community and developed countries, Bosnian minister of foreign affairs Jadranko Prlic said at an economic summit of North African and Middle East countries in Egypt.
- Sarajevo assembley failed to approve cantonal ministers at its session in Sarajevo on Wednesday.
- Bosnian expert team for war crimes has so far exhumed 400 bodies from mass graves in the area of Kljuc. They are believed to be local population killed by Serbs during the war.
